Made by Crystal

Being nonverbal shouldn't mean
being left out.

I made CrystalTalk to help nonverbal people and anyone who doesn't want to talk communicate in VRChat. Whether speaking isn't possible, isn't comfortable, or you simply prefer not to use your mic, I wanted a simple way to join the conversation with a tap.

Use the phrase buttons, add your own, or type a message. You choose how to communicate.

What can CrystalTalk do?

A few taps. More ways to connect.

Say it with a button

Send a preset phrase straight to the VRChat chatbox, or type a message when you need different words.

Make it yours

Add custom phrases for the things you say often. Keep your connection settings saved for next time.

Find your connection

Try local discovery to find VRChat, or enter the computer's address and OSC port yourself.

Use the screen you have

Phone or tablet, portrait or landscape: the button layout adapts to the space available.

Get started

Download. Install. Connect.

iPhone & iPad

  1. Download the IPA to your Windows PC or Mac.
  2. Download Sideloadly from its official website and follow its setup requirements.
  3. Connect your unlocked iPhone or iPad by USB and trust the computer when prompted.
  4. Select the device in Sideloadly, choose the CrystalTalk IPA, and sign it with your Apple account. Enter credentials only in the signing tool.
  5. Follow the tool's instructions to trust the developer profile and enable Developer Mode if required, then open CrystalTalk.

Signing requirements and renewal periods depend on your account and tool. A free Apple account generally needs periodic re-signing.

Android phones & tablets

  1. Download CrystalTalk.apk on your Android device.
  2. Open CrystalTalk.apk from Downloads or your file manager.
  3. If prompted, allow that browser or file manager to install unknown apps.
  4. Tap Install, then open CrystalTalk. You can turn off the install permission afterward.

Future builds may require uninstalling the previous version if signing keys differ. Uninstalling clears saved app settings.

Connect to VRChat

  1. Run VRChat on your computer. In VRChat's Action Menu, enable OSC.
  2. Put your phone or tablet on the same local network as the computer. Allow local network access when requested.
  3. Open CrystalTalk's connection settings and try discovery. If needed, enter your computer's local IPv4 address and OSC input port, normally 9000.
  4. Press a phrase button and check that its text appears in VRChat. A sent status alone doesn't confirm that VRChat received it.

On Android, use your computer's local IPv4 address and OSC port 9000.

A few things to know

Does it work with standalone Quest or consoles?

These downloads are companion apps for sending OSC to VRChat on a computer. Standalone Quest and console setups are not supported by this release.

Nothing appears in the chatbox. What should I check?

Check OSC is enabled, the target address and port are correct, and the devices share a network. Guest Wi-Fi, VPNs, and firewall rules can prevent local communication. Permit the relevant app on your private network rather than disabling the firewall.

Can I change the phrase buttons?

Yes. Add your own phrases and use the app's editing controls. On Android, long-press a custom button to edit or delete it.

Is CrystalTalk an official VRChat app?

No. CrystalTalk is an independent project created by Crystal. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by VRChat.
